how_to_prove: ALL of proof.required, then at least one of proof.effect (prefer confidence=live entries). The cast reply carries runes_spent, cooldown_started, effects.{ge,tags}, spell_actor, landed_at, moved_m, target_after, target_health; jump/air-dash proofs need their probe.

signal_kinds.runes_spent: carried rune counts fall by `cost` (cast reply: data.runes_spent)
signal_kinds.tag_added: gameplay tag `tag` appears on the pawn's GameplayEffectsComponent (data.effects.tags)
signal_kinds.ge_added: a GameplayEffect instance whose class contains `class_contains` appears on the pawn (data.effects.ge)
signal_kinds.spell_actor: a new UtilitySpell/actor of class `class` appears `near` the preview point or the target (data.spell_actor, data.landed_at)
signal_kinds.jump_apex_gain_m: jump apex after the cast exceeds the apex before by at least `min` metres (probe: client_mod/commands/smoke_jump.lua)
signal_kinds.air_dash_m: jump + one IA_Player_Evade press while falling ends at least `min` m away horizontally, kept by the server (probe: client_mod/commands/air_dash_test.lua; without the spell the server snaps him back)
signal_kinds.moved_m: the cast itself moves the caster at least `min` metres (data.moved_m)
signal_kinds.target_gone: the targeted thing is gone/converted after the cast (data.target_after == 'gone')
signal_kinds.target_health_drop: the targeted thing's health falls by at least `min` (data.target_health vs before)
signal_kinds.drops_spawned: world items whose item id contains `item_contains` appear near the target (look/census)
signal_kinds.held_item_effect: the held weapon gains the enchant: its damage types include `damage_types` for `time_limit_s` (pawn PlayerEquipmentComponent held effect; to be read)
signal_kinds.world_module: the spell changes the world through game module `module` (crop growth, water, compost ...); the proof needs a module-specific read (TBD)
signal_kinds.needs_live_observation: no observable module in the spell data (Blueprint-only): watch tags / GE / position / targets on a live cast, then add a LIVE entry
signal_kinds.view_target: the camera view target switches to class `class` while the spell is active (data.effects.view_target)
signal_kinds.input_mode: the player input mode while the spell is active contains `contains` (data.effects.mode)
signal_kinds.dodge_distance_gain_m: a ground dodge travels at least `min` m farther than without the spell (probe not built yet)
